PREVIOUS: CURRENT RELEASE (built, dev pending): v2026.1012.0-isol8.2 (fork PR #29 merged into isol8/2026.1012-rebase, merge 4ba87b309; GHCR digest above). WHAT CHANGED vs isol8.1: a stopped hermes_gateway task continues on the next comment the Paperclip-native way. Cherry-picked upstream (unmerged) paperclipai/paperclip#15982 (adapter modules may declare supportsConversationContinuation) and #14216 (hermes_gateway honours Paperclip cancel: calls Hermes POST /v1/runs/{id}/stop and acknowledges the cancellation only when Hermes reports a cancelled terminal status; fixes upstream #15099/#14206). Ours: hermes_gateway opts in, but is RECEIPT-ONLY: a run is stamped continue_conversation_v1 only when the adapter reports remoteExecutionStopped:true (terminal Hermes status, confirmed stop, cancel before create, 4xx create rejection other than 409) and a resumable session strategy (issue/agent). Restart-interrupted runs, unconfirmed stops/timeouts and ambiguous create failures keep legacy_execution_requires_reconciliation. Stop/status/create requests have deadlines. GET /api/adapters does not advertise the capability for hermes_gateway. No migration, no env change; rollback to 4dc88143-1f73936 is safe. Lightbulb's BFF cancel (#4175) also stops the turn; now redundant but harmless (the bridge answers 200 for an ended run). CURRENT RELEASE: v2026.1012.0-isol8.1 (fork PR #28, branch isol8/2026.1012-rebase against base branch upstream/v2026.1012.0, commit 4dc88143d; GHCR digest above). It replays the isol8 stack (net v2026.916.1...v2026.916.1-isol8.4) onto upstream paperclipai/paperclip v2026.1012.0 (v2026.1001.0 + v2026.1005.0 + v2026.1012.0). MIGRATIONS / ROLL FORWARD ONLY: upstream now owns 0280-0305, so fork migrations 0280-0283 are renumbered byte-identical to 0306-0309. The migrator matches applied migrations by SQL content hash, so a database that ran isol8.4 sees 0306-0309 as applied and applies only upstream's 26 new migrations (0280-0305; all additive, 0298 backfills connection instructions) on first boot via PAPERCLIP_MIGRATION_AUTO_APPLY. Verified offline against the dev AND prod __drizzle_migrations hashes (283 rows each; exactly 26 pending). isol8-migration-renumber.test.ts builds an isol8.4-shaped DB and upgrades it. Take an Aurora snapshot before the prod promote. ROLLBACK: the 26 upstream migrations are additive for isol8.4 code (0289 drops a column isol8.4 never had; 0285 widens assets.byte_size to bigint), and isol8.4's hash migrator ignores the unknown rows and finds nothing pending, so the ECS circuit-breaker rollback to the isol8.4 image boots on the migrated schema; it stays enabled. Restoring the snapshot is only for a data problem. UPGRADE RULE (upstream v2026.1012.0): old and new Paperclip processes must never run together (OS-backed SQLite restore locks under <instance root>/locks; the new task also migrates the shared schema). PaperclipStack now deploys stop-first (minHealthyPercent 0 / maxHealthyPercent 100): ECS stops the old task before the new one boots, at the cost of a short Paperclip gap per task-def change. Our instance root is the task's ephemeral disk, so no legacy <hash>.lock/ dirs carry over. UPSTREAM SEMANTICS TO KNOW: @-mentions no longer wake agents (v1005 #14577; skill + CEO checklist updated); new agents get default configuration grants (#15283); stored tool grants are enforced as written (#14915); silent active runs are flagged after 5/15 min (no cancel); legacy Composio broker removed; /api/auth/preferences and keyboardShortcuts removed; MCP aggregators on without a flag. Instance flags enableIsolatedWorkspaces / enableIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault exist and stay off (default false). enableNativeRunner defaults true upstream; we keep it false via paperclip_instance_flags. hermes_gateway adapter is unchanged upstream since 916.1. NEW FORK FIXES IN THIS RELEASE: company delete sequences upstream's browser_use_* tables (NO ACTION FKs); hmac_sha1 merged with upstream's app_webhook/fireflies_hmac and reads native x-vercel-signature / X-Hub-Signature; routine auto-pause overrides persist (board only); a routine run's failure counts once (marker row) and native recovery blocks feed the breaker; restore/re-enable clears breaker state; keyed agent-key, routine and company creates finish a lost audit on retry and attribute it to the creator; key rotations on replay are audited; isol8 notify token goes only to the bundled plugin package path; routine reviewer selector refuses multi-stage policies. The upstream tag's lockfile missed two server deps and was refreshed. PREVIOUS: CURRENT RELEASE: v2026.916.1-isol8.4 (fork PR #27, branch isol8/2026.916-rebase, merge 04f2b5d8d; GHCR digest above). WHAT CHANGED vs isol8.3: deleting a goal or project returned 502 (SQLSTATE 23503) whenever any task, cost or finance row still pointed at it. goalService.remove / projectService.remove now null those references (issues, projects.goal_id, cost_events, finance_events; sub-goals re-parent to the deleted goal's parent) and delete in one transaction. No migration, no env change. PREVIOUS: CURRENT RELEASE: v2026.916.1-isol8.2 (fork PR #25, branch isol8/2026.916-rebase, commit 8663fb337; GHCR digest above). It replays the isol8 stack onto upstream paperclipai/paperclip v2026.916.1 (839 upstream commits past the 813 base). WHY: upstream fixed the two mechanics behind the 09-23 incidents. (1) The orphan reaper is lease-based and safe across rolling deploys (dbf5ea432d, migration 0273), so a deploy no longer reaps in-flight runs. (2) Exhausted recovery escalates to the BOARD and keeps the assignee (f572e08678, policy board_escalation_no_takeover_v1). Owner ruling 2026-09-24: Paperclip owns escalation and Lightbulb #3079 is retired once the recovery-action card is ported. UPSTREAM SEMANTICS TO KNOW: setup_failed is non-retryable and blocks on the FIRST failure; process_lost gets 1 retry; timeout gets up to 3. Our PAPERCLIP_REQUIRE_GOVERNED_AGENT_CREATION env var was never read by any fork release (fork PR #21 closed as superseded), so PaperclipAdminClient's agent create now always sends canCreateAgents=false unless a caller overrides it explicitly. Interactions default to resolverPolicy 'anyone' (10d0555189), so human confirmations pass human_only. No new env is needed. TRUST_PROXY is unnecessary because PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL is always a trusted origin and both the BFF and the proxy stamp a matching Origin. PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY and PAPERCLIP_DECISION_SIGNING_SECRET are still read from env and already supplied (paperclip-stack.ts). PROCESS: `upstream` is the fork GHCR image pinned by digest; `upstreamCommit` is the FORK commit and drives the extended ECR tag. Merging a bump here runs build-paperclip-image.yml (a thin re-tag into ECR `extendedImage` so ECS can pull with execution-role creds); its tag then goes into `dev.tag` (validate) and `prod.tag` (promote) in follow-up PRs.
